summary.text: Melissa Oremus is a Republican state representative from Aiken who has represented South Carolina House District 84 since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A small business owner, Oremus serves on the House Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee.

paragraphs.text: Oremus was born in Aiken and earned a B.S. from the University of South Carolina Aiken in 2001 and a master's degree in management from Southern Wesleyan University in 2008.
She served on the Mead Hall School Board from 2010 to 2017.
Oremus was elected in a special election on October 1, 2019, to fill the unexpired term of Ronnie A. Young, who died in office.
In the November 3 general election she faces Democrat Darnell Holston.
